description: PitchBook public fund profile: fund name, description, quick facts as PitchBook shows them publicly (strategy, status, manager, size, vintage, dry powder when public), domicile address, and the profile's FAQ answers (manager, type, status, notable and latest investments). Takes the PitchBook fund id (e.g. 11230-30F from pitchbook.com/profiles/fund/11230-30F). Via a premium residential proxy; subscriber-only performance data is not included. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_pitchbook_investors when you need PitchBook public profile of an investor, lender or advisor; finance_sec_nport_mutual_fund_holdings when you need recent SEC NPORT-P filings for one fund-company CIK. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
